I've written the round-136 task: **V-0.3c, which puts the marker row and marker menu into English**. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and the advisor was available and used twice.

**Round 135 result:** C passed it with browser checks at both screen sizes. Gate 135 published commit `70f1e42`, which is the baseline for round 136. V-0.3b is now marked done (მზადაა). C found one new Low, C-R135-01: the loop brace hint says `(Ctrl+L)` but the Loop button says `(Ctrl/Cmd+L)`. It went to the deferred Low list, which now has 188 entries.

**Round 136 task (decision D-29z101):**
- **Size:** 20 Georgian lines in the two marker files, 2 lines that only change quote marks, and 23 test lines in 4 files. That fits one round.
- **New strings object:** the markers get their own `studioMarkerStrings` with 21 exact English texts. Last round's "no new object" rule only covered texts that already had an object; markers had none.
- **Quote marks:** «» become “” everywhere on the marker surface. That includes the flag label and title and one test that finds a flag by its label.
- **Shortcut notation:** the previous/next marker tooltips use `Ctrl+←` / `Ctrl+→`, the same as their existing labels, so the brace-hint mismatch doesn't repeat.
- **Shared sentence:** the "name is empty" message for markers is the same sentence as the group rename message, which stays Georgian until V-0.3d. V-0.3d must use the same English, and that is recorded in the backlog.
- **Tests:** three "must not contain" checks move to English fragments, and two planned code changes must show they still catch errors. Six texts had no test that reads them on screen, so A adds one new test file for them. A also runs seven planned code-break checks (m38–m44) that must each turn named tests red.
- **Docs:** the out-of-date status in doc 111 (flagged by the gate-135 reviewer) gets fixed, and A writes a new doc 112.
- **Files:** A may touch 11 paths (2 of them new). All other 940 files are frozen; I checked the list and the starting copies of the 9 existing files.
- **C's browser checks:** at 1440 and 1280, C checks the header buttons, adding a marker (at the playhead, a duplicate, Esc, and at the start of a time selection), rename, delete, move, previous/next, the right-click and Shift+F10 menu, zero Georgian and zero «» on the marker surface, layout, the round-135 Follow tooltip, and the sign-in protection on the product route.
- **Ableton:** I re-read the Live 12 manual section on locators. Adding at the start of the time selection, double-click to play, moving by drag or arrow keys, Delete and Rename are confirmed there. The deliberate differences are "marker" instead of "locator", F2 instead of Ctrl R, and no launch quantization on previous/next.

**Status checks:**
- The next regression round is due on or after 2026-10-27.
- Saba's decision files (`ableton-decisions.md`, `design-ux-decisions.md`) don't exist yet.
- No Critical, High or Medium finding is open.
